source_clause: NEWPR3.) Choosing an avatar will only show available options. When selecting an avatar, a default choice will be highlighted (the next available default – not used by another user) so that the user does not need to make a choice before saving/completing setup. No two Profile’s can use the same Avatar.
leaf_desc_037: When a user enters the avatar selection screen, the system must automatically highlight a default choice (which must be the next available default avatar not used by another user). This ensures the user does not have to explicitly tap/make a choice before saving or completing the setup.
reasoning: 驗證目標：8.4（NEWPR3）—— 進入 avatar 選擇畫面時，系統自動 highlight 下一個未被使用之預設 avatar。關鍵情境條件：前段預設 avatar 須已被佔用，否則「下一個可用」與「第一個」不可分辨。為什麼這樣切：與 `069-01` 同節不同 leaf ——前者驗清單之內容，本條驗清單之初始選取狀態。

tcs.tc_title: Next available default avatar is highlighted automatically
tcs.test_item: Next available default avatar is highlighted automatically
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Two Driver Profiles exist, each using one of the first default avatars
2. A New Profile Setup is in progress
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the avatar selection screen of the New Profile Setup
2. Read the screen and check which avatar is highlighted
tcs.expected_result:
1. The avatar selection screen is displayed
2. An avatar is highlighted without any choice being made, and it is the next available default avatar
tcs.priority_basis: 預設 avatar 之自動 highlight
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **ER2 併驗兩件事** —— 「未做任何選擇即已有一個被 highlight」與「它是下一個可用之預設 avatar」。只驗前者，一個**永遠 highlight 第一個（含已被使用者）**之實作會通過；只驗後者則測不到「不必先選」這個條文之目的（`so that the user does not need to make a choice`）。pre-condition 令兩個 profile 各佔一個前段預設 avatar，**使「下一個可用」與「第一個」不是同一個**。
